verdict.rationale: Signifyd is documented only as a hosted service: merchants send order data to Signifyd's REST API for fraud review and receive decisions or webhooks back. Nothing in the pack describes a self-hosted, on-premises, or open-source deployment of the core product. Self-hosting is a fair deployment question for a fraud-protection service, so the absence of evidence is 'none', not 'na'. The mobile SDKs and the device-profiling script are client-side integration pieces, not a self-hostable core.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
